vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 1.0.4

The skill is a legitimate Nginx configuration generator. The primary logic in `scripts/nginx.sh` consists of shell functions that output standard Nginx configuration templates to stdout based on user-provided arguments like domain and backend. It includes security best practices (e.g., HSTS, security headers, and disabling version tokens) and lacks any indicators of data exfiltration, unauthorized execution, or malicious intent.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions are consistent with an nginx configuration generator — it produces configuration templates and does not request unrelated credentials or install remote code — but provenance is unknown and part of the script was truncated in the manifest, so review before use.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (nginx config generation, reverse proxy, SSL, caching, security, optimization) match the included script (scripts/nginx.sh) which generates nginx config snippets and templates for reverse proxy, SSL, static hosting, security hardening, and load balancing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the user to run the CLI (help command) and otherwise contains usage notes — the runtime script only emits configuration files (heredocs) and does not read arbitrary files, exfiltrate data, execute remote commands, or automatically apply configs. It references common system paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live, /var/log/nginx) only as template values.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with an included script). There are no downloads or external installers; the only code is the bundled bash script, so nothing will be fetched or executed implicitly by an install process.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials. The script uses standard filesystem paths as defaults in generated text but does not attempt to read secrets or environment variables beyond normal CLI args.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system presence or modify other skills/configurations. The script only generates config text and contains no self-enabling or persistent behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward nginx configuration generator and is internally consistent. Before installing or running: 1) review the full scripts/nginx.sh file (the manifest shows the file truncated) to ensure there is no unexpected behavior; 2) do not pipe the script to sh from an untrusted source — save and inspect it first; 3) generated configs reference real system paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live, /var/log/nginx) — review and adjust paths and permissions to match your system; 4) the skill has no provenance (no homepage/source) — if you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher for source or use a well-known tool or repository; 5) applying generated configs to a production nginx should be tested on staging first and reloaded safely (nginx -t) rather than blindly replacing live configs.
